name: Watching Tv
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of guarding what we allow before our eyes, as seen in Psalms 101:3 where the psalmist commits to setting no wicked thing before his eyes. Jesus teaches in Matthew 5:28-29 that even looking with lust is equivalent to adultery in the heart and calls for radical action to avoid sin. The eye is described as the light of the body in Matthew 6:22, indicating that what we focus on shapes our spiritual condition. Believers are urged in Romans 12:2 and Galatians 6:8 to renew their minds and sow to the Spirit rather than the flesh, highlighting the need for discernment and spiritual vigilance in all visual intake, including watching television.
